what.text: This page follows refugees from the United Arab Emirates in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 252 Emirati refugees, and the United States hosted 45.2% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are the United Kingdom, Canada and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the United Arab Emirates, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 and 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1998 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 580, at the end of 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
